scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:web && bun run build:landing
scripts.build:landing: cd web/app && bun install && bun run build
scripts.pack: rom="$PWD/../Conker's Bad Fur Day (USA).z64" && CONKER_ROM="${CONKER_ROM:-$rom}" CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-net cargo run --release -p conker-extract -- pack --map 2d --map 30 --map 34 --map 3f --map 2b --map 1a --map 24 --background 2d=../lab/audio/captures/background_loop.wav --background 30=../lab/audio/map30/background_loop.wav --background 34=../lab/audio/map34/background_loop.wav --background 3f=../lab/audio/map3f/background_loop.wav --background 2b=../lab/audio/map2b/background_loop.wav --song 2b=../lab/audio/map2b/song_8a.wav --stem 2b=../lab/audio/map2b/background_stem.wav --background 1a=../lab/audio/map1a/background_loop.wav --background 24=../lab/audio/map24/background_loop.wav --song 24=../lab/audio/map24/countdown.wav
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run serve
scripts.test: rom="$PWD/../Conker's Bad Fur Day (USA).z64" && CONKER_ROM="${CONKER_ROM:-$rom}" CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-net cargo test -q -p conker-rules -p conker-sim -p conker-bots -p conker-anim -p conker-server -p conker-client -p conker-assets -p conker-extract -p extract-scene -p extract-character
scripts.check: cargo fmt --check && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-net cargo clippy -q -p conker-rules -p conker-sim -p conker-bots -p conker-anim -p conker-server -p conker-client -p conker-assets -p conker-extract -p extract-scene -p extract-character -- -D warnings && cd web/app && bun run check
